mechanism.one_liner: Thousands of traders broadcast intent. The swarm compresses that into shared maker price levels + venue weights. You keep your broker. You keep your capital. The swarm sells coordination — not custody.

Signal out: levels + broker-native order preview — you submit at YOUR broker.
No pooled book: Variant A never holds funds, never routes as a broker.
